Ali Chen: Hey payroll — quick heads up, my 2026-02-27 paystub looks wrong after my contractor -> full-time conversion last month. It shows CPP and EI still being deducted (Canada) *and* Social Security being withheld (US). I already uploaded my SSN and W-4 on 2026-02-10. Can someone confirm which tax regime we’re applying?

Jen (People Ops): @Ali Chen sorry about that, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the paystub snippet (redact amounts if you want) and the conversion date you have in Workday? Also did you check the Canada tax residency checkbox on onboarding?

Ali Chen: conversion date in Workday = 2026-02-01. I checked onboarding, I selected "Canadian resident working remotely" when I joined as a contractor in 2025. During conversion I tried to update to "US employee" (I moved to the US on 2026-01-28). I uploaded SSN photo and W-4. Paystub snippet:
```
YTD Tax Summary
Federal (US)    : Social Security 6.2%  - withheld
State (CA)      : CA SIT 4.0%           - withheld
International   : CPP 4.95%            - withheld
                : EI 1.58%             - withheld
Notes: Employment status: Full-time (converted 2026-02-01)
```

Ali Chen: feels like the payroll provider left the contractor-country tax flags on. Not sure if tax treaty applies or we should reverse CPP/EI and only keep US SS/Medicare.

Payroll Bot: Payroll ticket created #PR-8421. Assigned to: Sanket Rao. ETA initial review: 2 business days.

Sanket Rao: Thanks @Ali Chen — looking. Quick Q: when you converted did you submit a Canadian termination/last-day-of-contract record or was it a direct change of worker type in Workday? That can affect whether payroll runs close the Canadian payroll profile.

Ali Chen: It was a direct change of worker type (contractor -> employee) on the same worker profile. I didn't terminate the contractor record. HR migration checklist said not needed for conversions but maybe that was for same-country conversions.

Maria Gomez: tagging payroll ops — we recently updated the cross-border conversion playbook. If the contractor record wasn't terminated we sometimes get duplicate tax jurisdictions. There's a manual step to close the Canadian payroll account and set primary tax country=US.

Jen (People Ops): Sanket, can you check ADP/RemoteProvider to see if there are two active payroll assignments for the same worker (CA + US)? If so we need journal reversals and a corrective payroll run. Also check whether tax treaty override was requested — Ali, did you fill out any form for treaty or tie-breaker?

Sanket Rao: on it. Initial lookup shows two active payroll allocations in RemoteProvider: one with work_country=CA and payroll_type=contractor, and one with work_country=US payroll_type=employee. The CA payroll is still active and produced the CPP/EI deductions. I'll escalate for a manual close and request a tax correction.

Sanket Rao: next steps (quick): 1) Pause the CA payroll record, 2) run off-cycle reversal for CPP/EI with memo "erroneous jurisdiction after conversion", 3) issue adjusting paystub and YTD correction, 4) confirm Ali's SSN/W-4 are on US file. Jen, can People Ops approve the off-cycle reversal?

Jen (People Ops): Approved. Please include retro tax corrections in the ticket and cc payroll-audit for record-keeping. Ali — we'll need a signed attestation that you moved to the US on 2026-01-28 and that you did not have Canadian tax residency after that date (simple form). Can you upload that to the ticket?

Ali Chen: will upload attestation today. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Any estimate on timing for reversal + corrected paystub?

Sanket Rao: Once attestation is uploaded I'll request the off-cycle run today. If ops accepts, adjusted paystub should post within 3 business days and net correction on the next payroll. If ADP needs a formal journal, may be 1 additional pay cycle. I'll update PR-8421.

Maria Gomez: Also check benefits deductions — some benefit premiums were billed in CAD via the contractor profile. We should ensure premiums are switched to US plans and not double-billed. I'll coordinate with BenefitsOps.

Ali Chen: good catch — my dental was coming out in CAD as well. Thanks everyone.

Payroll Bot: Update on PR-8421: "Payroll record paused; off-cycle reversal scheduled; awaiting employee attestation."

Jen (People Ops): Closing loop — please mark the thread when corrected. If anyone else sees similar conversion issues, ping payroll ops before the next pay run. :raised_hands: 

Ali Chen: confirmed attestation uploaded and attached to PR-8421. Thanks team! :thumbsup:

Sanket Rao: Received attestation. Initiated off-cycle reversal, ADP ticket submitted. Will post final once adjusted stub is available.

Payroll Bot: PR-8421 status: Completed (adjusted paystub posted 1805004387).
